## [Growth] Competitor Research Agent

**WHAT IT IS**
Weekly Monday 6:30 AM Claude agent: scrapes CookUnity/HelloFresh/Factor/Sunbasket, parses local .eml competitor samples, generates 8 novel re-engagement hypotheses covering all 4 contact segments, and injects them into goal_experiments.

**WHAT IT SOLVES**
Automates competitive intelligence gathering. Hypothesis generation feeds the Goal Agent pipeline with externally-sourced ideas without manual research. Runs 30 min before Goal Agent picks them up at 9 AM.

**WHAT'S NEXT**
- Add confidence scoring to hypotheses for Goal Agent prioritisation
- Expand scrape targets (Freshly, Sunbasket)

nodes.name: Every Monday at 6:30 AM
nodes.notes: Cron: runs before Goal Agent (9 AM) so fresh hypotheses are ready to be picked up.

nodes.name: Run Competitor Research Cycle
nodes.notes: POST /api/agents/competitor-research — scrapes live competitor sites, parses .eml samples, generates 8 hypotheses via Claude, injects into goal_experiments table.

nodes.name: Log Result
nodes.notes: JS: logs hypothesis count, scrape success/failure per competitor, and any injection errors.
